data.one_liner: Interpolate numeric values to a multi‑color range with a simple API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Rainbow class that maps a numeric domain to a smooth gradient of two or more colors. Includes RainbowColorTween for use in Flutter animations as a drop‑in replacement for ColorTween.
use_when: You need to map data values to colors for charts or visualizations
You want smooth multi‑color transitions in animations without building a TweenSequence
avoid_when: You require a full theming engine or palette management
You need advanced color manipulation beyond linear interpolation
strengths: Simple, declarative API for color interpolation
Supports any number of colors in the spectrum
Integrates with Flutter animation system via RainbowColorTween
weaknesses: Only handles color interpolation, no broader theming features
No support for non‑Flutter platforms directly
